description: If shared relation clauses \(\Gamma\) represent the translated sentences \(T^E\) in each same nonempty expanded model, with all assignments quantified per clause, then \(T\) has a nonempty model if and only if \(\Gamma\cup\mathcal E_L\) has a nonempty clause model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.represented_theory_clause_reduction.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory)
  (Γ :
    Set
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L) ℕ))
  (hΓ :
    ∀ (N : ∅.ModelType),
      (∀ C ∈ Γ, ∀ (v : ℕ → ↑N), (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseToFormula C).Realize v) ↔
        ∀ A ∈ T, ↑N ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translate A) :
  T.IsSatisfiable ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable
      (Γ ∪ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.axiomClauses L)
